_doc: Corrections to journal_key.xls, applied by helpers.load_key_overrides() when journal_key is loaded. 'remove' drops the alias so the name is formatted as given; 'retarget' replaces a wrong or misspelled target. Each row states the spreadsheet's old_target and the loader raises if the spreadsheet no longer says that, so an edit to the .xls cannot silently collide with an override. Audit: verification/journal-alias-audit-2026-09-26.json.

overrides.evidence: NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Comp Neurol' = NLM 0406041 'The Journal of comparative neurology.' (ISSN 0021-9967); the old target is 'J Comput Neurosci' = NLM 9439510 'Journal of computational neuroscience.' (ISSN 0929-5313, founded 1994).

NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Comp Physiol' = NLM 7502104 'Journal of comparative physiology.' (ISSN 0302-9824). No journal titled 'Journal of Computational Physiology' exists.
NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Comp Physiol' = NLM 7502104 'Journal of comparative physiology.' (dotted form of the same abbreviation).
NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Comp Physiol A' = NLM 8413199 'Journal of comparative physiology. A, Sensory, neural, and behavioral physiology.' (c1984-c2001).

NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Exp Psychol' = NLM 7502586 'Journal of experimental psychology.' (ISSN 0022-1015, the undivided journal to 1974). JEP: General (1975-) is a different serial, abbreviated 'J Exp Psychol Gen'.

Misspelling of 'Journal of Experimental Psychology' (NLM 7502586). The old target 'JEP: General' is a different serial begun in 1975 (NLM 'J Exp Psychol Gen'); the same rule is already applied to 'journal of experimental psychology; journal of experimental psychology' by preserve_identity in helpers.py.

NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'Psychon Sci' = NLM 0360135 'Psychonomic science.' (ISSN 0033-3131, 1964-1972). Psychological Science is a different journal (APS, begun 1990).

Psychometric Monographs is the Psychometric Society's numbered monograph series (e.g. No. 1, Thurstone 1938, Primary Mental Abilities), separate from the journal Psychometrika (ISSN 0033-3123). Neither NLM nor Crossref /journals indexes the monograph series (both queried 2026-09-26, 0 hits).

overrides.source: journal of the royal statistical society. series c (applied statistics)
overrides.old_target: journal of the optical society of america
overrides.new_target: journal of the royal statistical society series c: applied statistics
overrides.evidence: Crossref /journals: 'Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series C (Applied Statistics)' ISSN 0035-9254/1467-9876. The old target, Journal of the Optical Society of America (NLM 7503097, ISSN 0030-3941), is an unrelated journal.

overrides.source: journal of the optical society of america [a]
overrides.old_target: journal of the optical society of america
overrides.new_target: journal of the optical society of america a
overrides.evidence: NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Opt Soc Am A' = NLM 8402086 'Journal of the Optical Society of America. A, Optics and image science.' (ISSN 0740-3232, 1984-) is distinct from 'J Opt Soc Am' = NLM 7503097 (ISSN 0030-3941, to 1983).

NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Gerontol' = NLM 0374762 'Journal of gerontology.' (ISSN 0022-1422, to 1994); 'The journals of gerontology' (Series A/B, 1995-) are successor serials, e.g. NLM 9508483 'J Gerontol B Psychol Sci Soc Sci' (ISSN 1079-5014). The plural title names the successor, not Journal of Gerontology.

overrides.source: journals of gerontology: series b: psychological sciences \& social sciences
overrides.new_target: the journals of gerontology series b
overrides.evidence: NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): NLM 9508483 'The journals of gerontology. Series B, Psychological sciences and social sciences.' (ISSN 1079-5014). Old target 'journal of gerontology' is NLM 0374762 (ISSN 0022-1422). New target matches this table's existing alias for the Series B full title.

NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Neural Transm Suppl' = NLM 0425126 'Journal of neural transmission. Supplementum.' (ISSN 0303-6995), a separate serial from Journal of Neural Transmission.

Crossref work 10.1037/h0092987 (Thorndike 1898) has container-title 'The Psychological Review: Monograph Supplements', ISSN 0096-9753 (NLM 19920010R 'Psychological monographs.'), a separate serial from Psychological Review.

overrides.source: proceedings of the royal society of london a
overrides.old_target: proceedings of the royal society of london
overrides.new_target: proceedings of the royal society of london series a
overrides.evidence: NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'Proc R Soc Lond A Math Phys Sci' = NLM 7505888 'Proceedings of the Royal Society of London. Series A, Mathematical and physical sciences.' (1905-1990, ISSN 0950-1207). Dropping the series letter names the undivided pre-1905 Proceedings; this table already keeps the series for 'series b'.

overrides.source: proc. intl. soc. mag. reson. med.
overrides.old_target: proceedings of the society for magnetic resonance in medicine
overrides.new_target: proceedings of the international society for magnetic resonance in medicine
overrides.evidence: The source abbreviates 'Proceedings of the International Society for Magnetic Resonance in Medicine' (ISMRM, formed 1994 by merging SMRM and SMRI); the old target names the predecessor Society of Magnetic Resonance in Medicine.

overrides.old_target: proceedings of the national association for computational linguistics
overrides.new_target: proceedings of the conference of the north american chapter of the association for computational linguistics: human language technologies
overrides.evidence: NAACL-HLT = Conference of the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics: Human Language Technologies (ACL Anthology venue 'naacl'); no 'National Association for Computational Linguistics' exists. New target is the booktitle already used by 3 cdl.bib entries.
'Proc. IEEE' is Proceedings of the IEEE (ISSN 0018-9219). The old target 'IEEE Proceedings' is not a journal title and is easily confused with the IET/IEE 'IEE Proceedings' series.

overrides.source: proceedings of the {aaai} 2008 workshop on wikipedia and artificial intelligence
overrides.old_target: proceedings of the association for the advancement of artificial intelligence
overrides.evidence: The AAAI 2008 Workshop on Wikipedia and Artificial Intelligence (MilnWitt08, AAAI workshop technical report WS-08-15) is a workshop, not the AAAI conference proceedings named by the old target.

overrides.old_target: proceedings of the international congress on acoustics
overrides.new_target: proceedings of the international conference on independent component analysis and blind signal separation
overrides.evidence: The only cdl.bib user (DeloEtal01, San Diego 2001, 'independent component analysis' in the title) is ICA 2001, the 3rd International Conference on Independent Component Analysis and Blind Signal Separation. The old target, International Congress on Acoustics, is an unrelated meeting.

'Memory Systems' is vol. 3 of the reference work 'Learning and Memory: A Comprehensive Reference' (Academic Press, 2008); the old target 'learning and memory' is the name this table gives the CSHL journal Learning & Memory (rows 'learning \& memory', 'learning {\&} memory').

overrides.source: zeitschrift f{\"u}r psychologie und physiologie der sinnesorgane
overrides.evidence: Historical title (1890-1906) of the serial that then split into Zeitschrift fur Psychologie and Zeitschrift fur Sinnesphysiologie; the alias erases the historical title, the same reason preserve_identity already exists in helpers.py. Title history from domain knowledge: NLM has no record for the old title (esearch 'Z Psychol Physiol Sinnesorg' returned 0); UNCONFIRMED against a catalogue.

Erganzungsband is the journal's numbered supplementary-volume series, separate from the journal issues; the old target drops it. New target keeps the series and fixes the source's 'eganzungsband' typo.
NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'Physiol Rev' = NLM 0231714 'Physiological reviews.' (ISSN 0031-9333). 'Physiological Review' (singular) is not a journal title.
NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'Int J Psychophysiol' = NLM 8406214 'International journal of psychophysiology' (ISSN 0167-8760); old target misspells 'phychophysiology'.
NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): NLM 8406214 'International journal of psychophysiology'; old target misspells 'phychophysiology'.

overrides.old_target: journal of clinical and experimental neuropyschology
overrides.new_target: journal of clinical and experimental neuropsychology
overrides.evidence: NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'J Clin Exp Neuropsychol' = NLM 8502170 'Journal of clinical and experimental neuropsychology.' (ISSN 1380-3395); old target misspells 'neuropyschology'.

overrides.source: journal of experimental psychlogy: human perception and performance
overrides.old_target: journal of experiment psychology: human perception and performance
overrides.new_target: journal of experimental psychology: human perception and performance
overrides.evidence: Old target reads 'journal of experiment psychology: ...'; the journal is Journal of Experimental Psychology: Human Perception and Performance (NLM 'J Exp Psychol Hum Percept Perform', ISSN 0096-1523).

A truncated 'Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition'. cdl.bib HEAD entries AshbEtal88 (14(1):33-53, 1988), DoshEtal89 (15(5):868-886), AndeFinc94 (20(6):1322-1340), Brow97 (23(4):898-914) and AndeEtal99a (25(5):1120-1136) carry 'Learning and Memory' with JEP:LMC volume numbers; the CSHL journal Learning & Memory began in 1994 at vol 1. The fragment is too short to retarget safely, so the alias is dropped.

NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'Psychol Forsch' = NLM 0435063 'Psychologische Forschung.' (ISSN 0033-3026); Crossref /journals agrees. 'Psychologie Forschung' is not the title.

NLM Catalog (esearch/esummary db=nlmcatalog, 2026-09-26): 'Alzheimer Dis Assoc Disord' = NLM 8704771 'Alzheimer disease and associated disorders.' (ISSN 0893-0341); the old target adds a possessive the title does not have.
Crossref /journals: 'Reliability Engineering & System Safety' (Elsevier, ISSN 0951-8320); old target reads 'systems'.
Old target misspells 'intellience' (AISTATS).
Old target misspells the acronym 'coysne'; the meeting is Cosyne (Computational and Systems Neuroscience).
The book is 'Youmans Neurological Surgery' (5th ed., H R Winn ed., Saunders 2004); old target reads "youman's neurosurgical surgery".
